T01.description: Correct the US order us-201 amount in week 46 and find every affected saved calculation and report.

T02.description: A late week-46 UK refund changes evidence reused by later company and EU operations runs.

T03.description: Correct both EUR and GBP conversion rates for week 46; locate all dependent USD metrics and briefs.

T04.description: Restate a week-45 EU order used by the already composed company summary.

T05.description: A US customer support ticket arrives in week 46; financial revenue evidence should remain reusable.

T06.description: An old week-44 order is corrected. Determine whether week-46 reports require revalidation.

T07.description: A week-45 refund and a week-46 support ticket arrive together; identify their combined impact.

T08.description: Two week-45 US order corrections offset, leaving the regional aggregate equal while its inputs changed.

T09.description: The currency conversion tool version was replaced. Its code-defined arithmetic is unchanged but prior receipts need revalidation.

T10.description: The week-46 exchange-rate source is unavailable. Dependent reports must block instead of serving stale numbers.

T11.description: After correcting the week-45 EUR exchange rate, restart the application before deciding what to refresh.

T12.description: A newly composed two-week comparison reuses past artifacts. A week-45 refund correction must reach that new report.
